PreToolUse.meaning: Runs before a tool call and can block it.

claude.reason: The trigger is established; Claude documents exact-list or regex matchers and multiple handler types.

codex.reason: The trigger is established; pinned Codex evidence covers command handlers and leaves matcher values provider-native.

cursor.reason: The trigger is established; Cursor keeps matcher values provider-native and prompt handlers are not available in cloud.

UserPromptSubmit.meaning: Runs as the user submits a prompt, before agent processing.

claude.scope: trigger only; not matcher, payload, output effects, or runtime behavior
claude.reason: Claude documents the prompt submission trigger before processing.

codex.scope: trigger only; not matcher, payload, output effects, or runtime behavior
codex.reason: Codex documents the prompt submission trigger before processing.

cursor.scope: trigger only; not matcher, payload, output effects, or runtime behavior
cursor.reason: Cursor documents the pre-submission trigger and Core resolves the source alias.

WorkspaceOpen.meaning: Runs when a workspace opens in the IDE.

claude.scope: pinned native event inventory and Skillset source name resolution
claude.reason: There is no WorkspaceOpen source resolution in the pinned Claude inventory.

codex.scope: pinned native event inventory and Skillset source name resolution
codex.reason: There is no WorkspaceOpen source resolution in the pinned Codex inventory.

cursor.scope: pinned native event inventory and Skillset source name resolution
cursor.reason: Cursor documents this as an IDE-only event; it is not a portable session-start alias.
